title: GridSim v1 asset-classes.json
description: The asset (dynamics and protection) classes of the case, one record each. Optional file. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

assetClass.title: Asset class
assetClass.description: One asset class (v1 AssetClassDto): a kind, a free-text mode, numeric parameters and their provenance. The honesty rule (a CuratedPlaceholder note must contain [VERIFY]) and the per-kind parameter checks are the loader's (AssetClassLibrary.ValidateOrThrow). Absent: name/kind/mode empty, no params, no provenance.

name.title: Name
name.description: Class name; generators, lines, transformers, bindings and protections refer to it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the class models. Canonical names are the camelCase ones; the loader also accepts the aliases listed (it ignores case, this schema does not). synchronousMachine and its alias machine are not listed (D-DOC-149): the loader parses them but refuses the class, because GridSim has no controller for an authored machine class (a synchronous machine's inertia comes from its generator's inertiaH and capacityMva).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Free-text label (for example grid-following). Absent: empty.

params.title: Parameters
params.description: Numeric parameters by name. Absent: none.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Where each parameter came from, by parameter name ('_default' covers the rest). Absent: none.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: A provenance tag and a note (v1 ProvenanceDto). Absent: tag CuratedPlaceholder, note empty.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Exactly a member name of GridSim.Core.Diagnostics.ProvenanceTag (the loader ignores case; this schema does not).

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain-English source note; a CuratedPlaceholder note must contain [VERIFY]. Absent: empty.
